items.title: Tom Lellis interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, July 31, 2007
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] I had an experience once when I was in school, at a public school, and I played the beginning of the Paul Simon record — [INTERVIEWEE] Yeah. With Milton or —

ctx.x: I have. Yes. And I’ve — Toninho Horta who is a collaborator of mine, is in New York now, we’ve just been talking, so I may go down there to record with him. But I have been to Brazil and the people walk with rhythm. It’s a beautiful thing.
